d:
Enjoy the full song "Yeh Jo Thode Se Hain Paise" from the Bollywood movie 'Papa Kehte Hain' starring Jugal Hansraj, Mayuri Kango, Soni Razdan, Tiku Talsania, Alok Nath, Anupam Kher, Dinesh Hingoo. This beautiful song is in the voice of the eminent singer Kumar Sanu. And the lyrics are penned by Javed Akhtar.
Song : Yeh Jo Thode Se Hain Paise
Album : Papa Kehte Hain
Star cast : Jugal Hansraj, Mayuri Kango, Soni Razdan, Tiku Talsania, Alok Nath, Anupam Kher, Dinesh Hingoo
Singer : Kumar Sanu
Music Director : Rajesh Roshan
Lyricst : Javed Akhtar
Music Label : T-Series
